limitations: This records a completed, scoped engine review; no scanner, runtime test or contract comparison was rerun while authoring these evidence files.
Zero confirmed findings is not a guarantee that the project, all dependencies or every deployed configuration has no vulnerability.
No production website was attacked or penetration tested. UI, hosting configuration, server services and repository history were outside this engine audit.
The scanner is pattern based. Its zero results were supplemented by manual boundary review; scanner output alone is not a proof of safety.
Historical comparison and scanner results were captured in prior tool outputs. Dedicated raw-output log files were not saved for those completed review calls.

Output was previousCount=74, currentCount=144, compared=74, differences=[]. This is a contract equality check rather than byte equality of source files or a reimplementation of the 74 kernels.
retainedRegistryContract.expressionProvenance: The comparison expression was executed in the completed review tool call; its contract projection and exact output are described in method. This public report does not claim to contain a replayable raw command transcript.

keywordCandidatesResolved.origin: separate rg keyword search, not a scanner finding
keywordCandidatesResolved.resolution: The reference is pair.privateKey obtained from a fresh Web Crypto key pair. No hardcoded private key material, secret export or persistent key storage was found at this boundary.

checks.name: closed-dispatch
checks.observation: Registry lookup, the fixed expansion ID set, fixed switch cases and an Object.hasOwn-checked frozen function map select approved implementations. Model text cannot supply a custom executable kernel or host function name.

checks.name: generated-code-data-boundary
checks.observation: Model IDs, parameter values and metadata enter generated TypeScript through JSON.stringify data literals with U+2028/U+2029 escapes. Fixed trusted templates contain implementations. Expression text is omitted from exported parameters in favor of the compiler-owned bounded AST. No eval, new Function or unsafe HTML sink was found in the audited engine/generator scope.

checks.name: finite-domain-shape-unit-and-index-validation
checks.observation: Strict model fields and safe identifiers, finite homogeneous dense signals, approved parameter names/kinds/options/ranges/lengths, integer indices, source sizes, matching shapes and physical units are validated before execution. Real-domain failures, zero divisors and nonfinite emitted values produce ModelError diagnostics with block positions.

checks.name: bounded-computation
checks.observation: Existing compile/runtime memory, record, solver, operation and wall budgets are retained. Convolution uses length-product cost; polynomial cost includes coefficient count; median/sort and the six time sources have explicit weighted costs. Continuous changing jump functions remain subject to discontinuity registration restrictions.

checks.name: local-only-mathematical-runtime
checks.observation: Audited mathematical helpers perform local deterministic calculations. No fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, child process, filesystem, network, persistent browser storage or host-time source was found in the new helper boundaries. Runtime elapsed-time checks remain local resource controls.

checks.name: signed-declarative-package-boundary
checks.observation: Schema/hash/signature, exact engine/schema versions and the complete approved registry contract (block ID/version, ports and parameter kinds) are verified. Exactly local-model is permitted. Unknown executable sources, dependencies or host/network/file permissions are rejected. Every export generates a fresh nonextractable private signing key and exposes only the public key/fingerprint. An embedded public key verifies integrity and never creates sender trust; acceptance separately checks an independently obtained exact SHA-256 public-key fingerprint and executable semantic diagnostics. No private key persistence is implemented.

securityEightAreas.reason: These local engine libraries have no database queries or database service boundary.

No HTML sink or dynamic model-to-code execution exists in the audited engines. Generated model content remains JSON data; trusted kernels use closed dispatch. App UI was not included in this 26-file scan.
No hardcoded secret material was found in the examined sources. The separately reviewed privateKey keyword is an ephemeral Web Crypto handle. Repository history and unrelated files were not included.
No account/session/server route is present in the audited local libraries. Package sender trust and permissions are applicable boundaries and were reviewed separately above.
Native/declarative model schemas, finite types, identifiers, units, shapes, domains, sizes and resource bounds are enforced before execution and at emitted values.
There is no login, paid API or server request endpoint here. Local calculation, model input and recording budgets apply and were checked; these are not claims about a server rate limiter.
The audited mathematical libraries neither expose cookie-authenticated HTTP mutation routes nor configure hosting headers/TLS. Deployed hosting security is outside this record.
No database, database role or RLS layer is used by these engine libraries.

dependencyAudit.timestampMeaning: The upstream npm audit JSON has no embedded query timestamp. sourceArtifactWrittenAtUtc is the source file write time, not a guaranteed npm registry query start time.
dependencyAudit.limitation: This copies the already completed dependency advisory lookup. No dependency audit was rerun; zero reported advisories is not proof that every dependency is free of vulnerabilities.
